verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for secret-scanning products, many of which are hosted, and gitleaks.io describes team-wide PR and commit scans, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any region selection, data-residency control, or statement about where scan data or findings are stored. The local CLI scan commands (git, dir, stdin) show local execution, but that is not a documented residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
